text: Reception reported 91 of 183 rooms occupied on Tuesday 24 Nov (49.7%), 43 of them Rabdan, down from 93 on 23 Nov. There were no check-ins and 2 check-outs (rooms 801 and 1105). Reception logged 3 new inquiries, 2 property viewings, no booking confirmations, 1 renewal confirmed, and 4 guest complaints, all resolved.

Reports for 24 Nov came from the operations update, Reception, Maintenance, IT, Accounts, HR & Admin and AJ1881. The Flower shop and Housekeeping reports were not seen, and neither was the Operations Manager’s own daily task report.

Maintenance logged 8 completed jobs, all marked done, including B3 drainage chamber and rainwater line cleaning, room 302 mixer tap and restroom lights, the room 301 leak, the room 702 cupboard and the B2 fire pump room FCU service. Still in progress: Basement 1 painting, basement fused lights, basement drainage chambers and the room 510 ceiling; the flap barrier needs vendor follow-up with Honest Automatic.

On 25 Nov Operations again asked for urgent approval of the elevator AMC (three quotations, Ever Gravity lowest). The room 801 guest is asking for a full refund or a two-day deduction after checking out. Faiz Investment Company has asked for a 30-minute meeting with Madam. AJ1881 again asked to buy critical supplies and to rename the shop Oui Cafe.
ADNOC’s HSE Compliance head replied on 25 Nov that he has signed and returned Blumont’s checklist internally and nothing further is needed from the HSE side. The contract itself is not yet confirmed.

Reneco has chased its Tawtheeq several times; Operations says the PRO needs UAE Pass access to finish it. The room 302 guest’s repeated complaints were worked on: Maintenance replaced the mixer tap and lights and IT fixed the Wi-Fi. Accounts verified November rent payments and reported no overdue rent and no cheques deposited or returned.

IT fixed a key-card fault in room 201, a door in room 102, room 302 Wi-Fi and the B3 maintenance PC, and finished camera cabling; the new cameras, the new internet connection set-up and the biometric attendance link are still in progress, and the Equal software is still slow. IT confirmed the old internet invoice does not need paying. AJ1881 sold AED 206 from 10 covers, all beverages.
